newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile June fishmeal output up 16.6 pct on 1996.
newsitem.headline: Chile June fishmeal output up 16.6 pct on 1996.

text.p: Chilean fishmeal production rose to 147,336 tonnes in June, up 16.6 percent on the same month last year, said the National Statistics Institute.
The figures showed fishmeal output in the first six months of the year was 16 percent lower than in the same period last year, mainly as the result of a sharp fall in output in April.
Chilean fishmeal production has been hit this year by a temporary bans on the fishing of mackerel, the main ingredient in fishmeal.
Production of fresh fish and seafood climbed 90 percent in June, with output of tinned fish rising 40 percent and production of frozen fish up 16 percent.
